subject: SIG evidence: HSM operator shift logs and TLS cipher inventory
messages:
From: Claire Sun <security@novabank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-20T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ request - HSM operator logs + TLS cipher inventory

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — Nova Bank is reconciling SIG/CAIQ evidence ahead of our SOC 2 intake. We need a few artifacts scoped to encryption & key management for the last 12 months to complete our review:

- HSM/operator shift logs (operator id, shift start/end, operator role) for all production HSM clusters. If you must redact operator PII, please redact but preserve operator IDs consistently so we can observe role continuity.
- Signed minutes for any KEK/KEK-wrapping rotation ceremonies (PDFs or signed meeting notes).
- TLS cipher inventory for inbound and outbound connections (ingress/egress) — current list plus snapshot for the last 12 months (csv ok).
- A short statement on key rotation policy (frequency, custodial model) and a sample rotation schedule or runbook excerpt.

We have a deadline of Nov 30 for the intake; would you be able to provide these artifacts by COB Nov 24? Also note: we need a secure transfer method (S3 presigned or secure upload) and a point of contact for redaction questions.

Appreciate it — Claire

Claire Sun
Senior Security Analyst, Nova Bank
security@novabank.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Claire Sun <security@novabank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ request - HSM operator logs + TLS cipher inventory

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped evidence package covering the last 12 months. High-level notes:

- We will provide redacted operator shift logs (we will keep operator IDs consistent across rows; we will redact phone numbers/emails).
- We can export signed rotation minutes for KEK ceremonies where signatures were captured; some older ceremonies used internal sign-off artifacts — we will flag any items that are administrative notes rather than signed minutes.
- TLS cipher inventory export (ingress/egress) will include timestamped snapshots; we’ll provide a current csv and a one-year snapshot file.
- I’ll include the key rotation policy excerpt and a sanitized sample runbook.

Question: do you require an executed NDA/Exchange Agreement before we upload artifacts, or is the normal secure intake link sufficient? We can provide via our secure share link (S3 with MFA-delete) or via your portal.

I’m copying Ben (security) and Marissa (legal) to coordinate redaction and transfer.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: SIG/CAIQ request - HSM operator logs + TLS cipher inventory

Team — forwarding Nova Bank request (below). They want artifacts by COB Nov 24. Proposed split:

- Ben: please produce redacted operator shift logs (csv). Keep consistent pseudonymous operator IDs (e.g., OP-001) and include role column (SME/operator/owner). Redact emails/phone numbers. Provide a short readme describing redaction mapping and retention window.
- Jonas: export TLS cipher inventory snapshots (current + quarterly snapshots for past 12 months). Include direction (ingress/egress) and service/endpoint mapping where available. CSV preferred.
- Marissa: review signed rotation minutes and confirm which documents are considered signed artifacts vs. internal notes; prepare a brief comment about any redaction we need to perform for signatures. Also advise whether we should ask for a Nova-specific NDA prior to transfer.

Target internal delivery to me by EOD Nov 22 so we have time to review and upload Nov 23. Claire asked for secure transfer options — I will use our secure share unless legal advises otherwise.

Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ request - HSM operator logs + TLS cipher inventory (evidence package)

Claire — attaching the scoped evidence package via our secure share link. Files included (redaction notes below):

Attachments (stubs in package):
- operator_shift_log_redacted_2027-11.csv (columns: operator_id, role, cluster, shift_start_utc, shift_end_utc, action_notes). Operator IDs are pseudonymized as OP-###; PII removed.
- tls_cipher_inventory_egress_ingress_2027-11.csv (columns: direction, endpoint, cipher_list, tls_version, snapshot_ts). Contains current export and quarterly snapshots.
- kek-rotation-minutes-2027-07-14-signed.pdf (scanned meeting minutes signed by ops lead and CTO). Where only internal admin notes existed we included them as separate files (marked _internal).
- key_rotation_policy_excerpt.txt (sanitized policy excerpt and sample rotation cadence).

Secure transfer: https://drive.redwood.com/secure-share/NOVA/enc-evidence-2027 (expires 2027-12-01). We have uploaded to a tenant-scoped S3 bucket with MFA protected upload. If you prefer your portal, we can push via presigned URL.

NDA: Marissa attached a short intake agreement (DocuSign link) to cover exchange of redacted operator-level logs; this is standard for extended evidence access. You can sign here: https://app.docusign.com/enclink/Agreement-REDWOOD-NOVA-2027

Redaction notes: operator emails/phone numbers and employee numbers removed. Timestamps are intact in UTC. KEK rotation minutes contain signatures; Marissa confirmed signatures may remain but we removed home/ personal contact details.

If you need additional scope (full, unredacted operator logs under an MSA/PIA), let us know and we can route for the legal/data governance approvals.

Thanks — Kim

Attachments in this email: operator_shift_log_redacted_2027-11.csv; tls_cipher_inventory_egress_ingress_2027-11.csv; kek-rotation-minutes-2027-07-14-signed.pdf; key_rotation_policy_excerpt.txt
